description: Was at the board, and was not given a subject.

description: Told the arch until he was allowed to stop.

description: Left the hall clear, and went up.

description: Was at the board for the knife, and then went up.
name: John Shakespeare

description: Kept the song off the board, and left the boats outside.
name: Judith Shakespeare

description: Sat, and was not given a subject.

description: Was at the board, and was not given a subject.

description: Sat, and did not go out again.
